data.description: Corner Unit | Immaculate Condition | Large Plot
data.long_description:
Experience serene community living in this spacious 2-bedroom villa located in the highly sought-after Springs 14. Set on a large plot, this home offers a perfect balance of indoor comfort and outdoor space, ideal for families or those seeking privacy within a green, gated neighborhood. With its tranquil surroundings and excellent connectivity, it’s a fantastic choice for both end-users and investors.

Property Highlights:

-Type 4E (corner unit)
-2 Bedroom + Study
-Immaculate condition
-All new A/cs
-Large private garden with well maintained grass
-New AC units
-Plot: 3537 sq. ft 
-Community pool and park

Property Amenities:

Gated community with 24/7 security
Swimming pools and children’s play areas
Scenic lakes and landscaped parks
Jogging and cycling tracks
Community retail centers
Pet-friendly environment

Location Highlights:

Located in Springs 14 within The Springs
Developed by Emaar Properties
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
10 minutes to Dubai Marina
15 minutes to Mall of the Emirates
Close to top schools and healthcare facilities
Nearby shopping centers and dining options
